caption:
A New Zealand officer who had lived beside Tarawa for fifteen years warned the Marines there would not be three feet of water on the reef. On the morning of the landing, the boats began to stop hundreds of yards from the beach.

Read it free: https://ww2dispatches.substack.com/p/the-tide-that-never-came
